notes: delay-gfp variant: busy-wait mdelay() of >=1ms used inside a sleepable context (workqueue handler, no atomic context). Wastes CPU; should call a sleeping primitive (usleep_range / msleep) instead. The pattern signature for CodeQL: a call to mdelay(N) with N >= 1 reachable from a function that is invoked only from non-atomic contexts (workqueue, kthread, syscall path) and does not run under spinlock/RCU/IRQ-disable.
